title: Optogenetic Stimulation of Superior Mesenteric Ganglion in Septic Shock Model
author: Kaitlin Murray
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wwbffan
materials: Locate the SMG superior mesenteric ganglion
Optional: aspirate and wash with wash buffer

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Stimulation
steps.instruction: Prepare the anesthetized mouse for surgical access to the superior mesenteric ganglion (SMG).

substeps.instruction: Place anesthetized mouse supine on a heating pad under a stereo dissecting scope.
Make a 1-inch incision on the right side of the mouse, directly under the rib cage.

steps.title: Perform Optogenetic Stimulation
steps.instruction: Apply optogenetic stimulation to the SMG and maintain tissue viability.

substeps.instruction: Place the fiber 1-2mm over the SMG and begin optogenetic stimulation (250mA, 10Hz, 2ms).
Continue stimulation for another 10 minutes.
Keep tissues moist with continual application of sterile 1X PBS and cover the wound with sterile gauze.

steps.title: Blood Collection and Serum Processing
steps.instruction: Collect blood and isolate serum for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Allow mouse to rest under anesthesia for 50 minutes.
Perform a cardiac puncture to draw blood serum and collect in a serum separator tube.
Centrifuge blood at 15000rpm for 5 mins at 4C.
Remove the top layer and store at -80C.

steps.title: Coat ELISA Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the Corning Costar 9018 ELISA plate with capture antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 48ul capture antibody to 12ml 1x Coating Buffer.
Coat the plate with 100ul/well of this capture antibody buffer.
Seal the plate and incubate overnight at 2-8C.

steps.title: Wash and Block Plate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate and apply blocking diluent.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate wells and wash 3x with >250ul/well washing buffer (1x PBS, 0.05% Tween 20), allowing ~1 minute soak between washes.
Blot on absorbent paper.
Dilute 5x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent with 4 parts DI water (e.g., 10ml of 5x ELISA/ELISAPOT to 40ml DI water).
Block wells with 200ul/well of 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent and incubate at RT for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Standards
steps.instruction: Reconstitute and dilute standards to create a calibration curve.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized standards by adding 0.8ml DI water to the vial; let sit for 15 minutes with gentle agitation.
Dilute reconstituted standard with 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent by adding 100ul of standard to 1400ul of 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent.
Add 100ul/well of the top standard concentration to appropriate wells.
Perform 2-fold serial dilutions of the top standards to create an 8-point standard curve (100ul/well).
Include at least 2 wells with 100ul/well of 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent as blanks.
Seal plate and incubate at RT for 2 hours (or overnight at 2-8C).

steps.title: Add Detection Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply the detection antibody to the plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 48ul detection antibody into 12ml of 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent.
Add 100ul/well of this dilution to the plate.
Seal plate and incubate for 1 hour at RT.

steps.title: Apply Avidin-HRP
steps.instruction: Apply the enzyme conjugate to the plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 48ul enzyme into 12ml 1x ELISA/ELISAPOT diluent.
Add 100ul/well of Avidin-HRP dilution to the plate.
Seal and incubate for 30 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Final Wash and Development
steps.instruction: Wash the plate and develop the signal using TMB.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate and wash, soaking wells in wash buffer for 1-2 minutes prior to aspiration; repeat 5-7 washes.
Add 100ul/well of 1x TMB solution to each well.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes, or until fully developed.
Add 50ul of stop solution to each well.

steps.title: Read and Analyze Plate
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Read plate at 450nm.
If λ subtraction is available, subtract the values of 570nm from those of 450nm and analyze.
